items.title: Eddie Dawson Interview, 1972-04-05
items.q: INTERVIEWEE: At least, uh, I don't remember, no. Did you ever hear her sing? No. You didn't even know what she sang? No.

ctx.x: Ann Cook, I know Ann Cook when I was running up there around, uh, uh, uh, Segretta, John Segretta, you know John Segretta had a ballroom at the corner of Franklin and, uh, Grab here. Well, she lived around there? And she lived right around the corner of Franklin and, uh, they all bum-dancing. So, Greta had a ballroom and that's where, uh, Lewis Armstrong and, uh, and this fellow called Shutz, trumpet player. Uh, what's his first name now? Lewis Madison. Matt, Matt, Madison. Yeah, Lewis Madison. They called him…

Did you know Genevieve Davis? She played piano and sang. She recorded the same day that Ann Cook did. Where'd she recorded from? She, well, she from here, she recorded with Louis Dumaine. You see they had Louis Dumaine's band. Louis Dumaine, yeah, Louis Dumaine, uh, uh. Yeah, and Ann Cook and, and Genevieve Davis sang with the band. You mean you never saw Ann Cook singing in the band? No.
At least, uh, I don't remember, no. Did you ever hear her sing? No. You didn't even know what she sang? No.
